signals.text: Revenue grew 29% a year over 3 years vs 32% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 16% vs revenue at 29%: profits are lagging sales.
Operating margin compressed 249 bps in 3 years (12.0% → 9.5%).
Borrowings grew 3.3x in 3 years while equity grew 1.3x: growth is being funded with debt.
Working-capital days shortened by 23 days in 3 years (51 → 28).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 43% of reported profit: profits are not converting to cash, a red flag.

guidance.statement: Jewellery business normalized EBIT margin is expected to remain around the 11% center of gravity.
guidance.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.

guidance.statement: Management targets healthy double-digit aggressive growth in the jewellery business.
guidance.quote: if you're looking for what is that we are targeting, we are targeting, as always, a double-digit aggressive growth, and that's something which we shared even in the Investor Day.

guidance.statement: TEAL's normalized margin is expected to gradually gravitate towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
guidance.quote: Overall, long term, growth is on a very strong wicket, but the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.

guidance.statement: CaratLane's normal margin trajectory should be towards 10% EBIT margin.
guidance.quote: So their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

delivered.statement: Reported strong all-round growth across all businesses, brands, and subsidiaries with good volume and buyer growth.
Consolidated customs duty rate increase gains realized at ₹407 crores for the quarter.
Normalized EBIT margin for Tanishq Mia Zoya business was 10.9% for the quarter.
Normalized EBIT margin for the watches division was 17.8% for the quarter.
CaratLane delivered an EBIT margin of 9.6% for the quarter.

calls.tone: confident on demand, resilient execution, and long-term growth despite short-term volatility

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on whether guidance should be revisited given improving buyer and studded growth.
Scepticism on maintaining 18-20% top-line growth if Y-o-Y gold price inflation drops to zero.
Questions on whether competitive pressure and discounting on plain gold and diamond jewellery have eased.
Inquiries on the economic impact and margin implications of cash-for-gold and exchange programs.

business.summary: Titan Company Limited operates diverse lifestyle businesses including Jewellery (Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane), Watches, Eyecare, and subsidiaries like TEAL, generating revenue through retail and manufacturing operations.

segments.name: Jewellery
segments.note: Includes Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, and CaratLane

guidance.statement: Titan expects a sustainable jewelry revenue growth rate of 15% to 20% over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: this is the medium to three to five-year horizon if you want to look at. This is the growth rate we are expecting. We are not giving any guidance to you for FY27.

guidance.statement: beYon aims to quickly scale up to 10 to 12 stores across two to three cities in Quarter 1.
guidance.quote: our objective currently is very soon to scale up to the next step of 10 to 12 stores and then kind of see how that works for us before planning a national launch.

delivered.statement: Jewellery division reported an 8% increase in buyer growth in Q4.
delivered.quote: we have seen resurgence in buyer growth in Quarter 4 and what we have reported is 8% versus a flattish for the period prior to that.

delivered.statement: Analog watches overall growth was around 16% for the full year.
delivered.quote: Analog watches overall growth has been around 16% for the year.

delivered.statement: Total Watches division overall growth was about 14% for the year.
delivered.quote: overall growth has been about 14% for the Watches division.

delivered.statement: CaratLane grew to the tune of 22% to 23% for the year.
delivered.quote: For CaratLane, specifically among other things, we have grown to the tune of 22%-23%, which is per se not bad.

delivered.statement: Titan gained about 50 to 60 bps of market share in jewellery in FY26 versus FY25.
delivered.quote: Our sense is that perhaps we have gained about 50 to 60 bps is our sense on FY26 versus FY25.

calls.tone: confident on long-term demand and formalization tailwinds, cautious on short-term gold volatility and margin pressures.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned potential cost increases and availability issues for gold sourcing due to import license delays.
Scepticism regarding the drivers behind the steep Q4 losses of Rs 82 crores in Middle East businesses.
Pressing management on whether the 11-11.5% domestic EBIT margin band is sustainable amidst rising gold prices and product mix shifts.
Questioning if the slowdown at CaratLane was due to customer shifts toward traditional gold jewellery over studded items.

guidance.statement: CaratLane will gradually inch towards double-digit EBIT margin.
guidance.quote: gradually, CaratLane with the scale will start inching towards double-digit EBIT margin.

guidance.statement: Eyewear volume growth is estimated to be around 8% to 10%.
guidance.quote: this is what we have estimated, around an 8% to 10% growth. So this is what we will continue to deliver.

delivered.statement: Jewellery division delivered 40% growth in Q3 FY26.
New buyer contribution to jewellery improved sequentially to 45% in Q3 from 42% in Q2.
Labour code impact was accounted for as an exceptional item of INR152 crores consolidated and INR138 crores standalone.
Eyewear domestic growth was almost 17.5% and omnichannel sale revenue growth was 11%.

calls.tone: Confident on demand and execution despite gold price volatility and margin pressures.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned gross margin dips and profitability impact in a rising gold price environment.
Pressed on flat buyer growth versus ticket size growth and studded jewellery performance trends.
Inquired about the sustainability and immunity of exchange programs and gold purchase plans against gold volatility.

guidance.statement: Targeting 35 to 40 new Tanishq store openings for the full year.
guidance.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.

guidance.statement: Watch division margins will gradually revert towards the 15% to 16% band over 1 to 2 years.
guidance.quote: they will gradually revert towards 16%, 17% band. And on a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.

guidance.statement: Eyecare growth is expected to close the year between 13% and 14%.
guidance.quote: So as far as our growth outlook is concerned, we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.

guidance.statement: YTD December growth rates in jewellery should become better than the first half growth rates.
guidance.quote: by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.

guidance.statement: EBIT absolute growth might be slightly slower than revenue growth for the full year due to gold price headwinds.
guidance.quote: I would expect EBIT growth, absolute amount growth might be slightly slower than the revenue growth for the full year.

delivered.statement: Watch festive period saw a 16% growth over the same period last year.
CaratLane margins expanded by 250 bps year-on-year to reach 10% in Q2.

calls.tone: confident on demand and festive momentum, cautious on margin pressures from soaring gold prices

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the sustainability of margins and whether historical high EBIT margins can be achieved given high gold prices.
Scepticism regarding the massive INR 9,500 crore increase in inventory and its impact on gold lease interest.
Concerns over new vertical integration and virtual solutions by emerging competitors in the eyewear segment.
Pressed on flat-to-declining buyer growth and whether volume elasticity is broken at high gold prices.

credibility.line: Management consistently meets segment margin and growth operational targets, but gold volatility and inventory scale cause quarterly margin fluctuations.
